entities.name: Relio Voldaren
entities.description: A brash, reckless vampire of the Voldaren clan of Stensia who was killed at Olivia's wedding.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire whose grand wedding is held at the Voldaren Estate; she invited the Domnathi.

entities.name: Cordelia Stromkirk
entities.description: Relio's companion who coldly stepped aside as he died.

entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: Powerful, feared vampire with demon alliances who killed Relio.

entities.name: Domnathi
entities.description: Vampires invited to the wedding by Olivia.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad home to the Voldaren clan.

events.summary: At the wedding Relio complains to Cordelia about the event and Olivia's decision to invite the Domnathi vampires.
events.quote: complaining about the event and Olivia Voldaren 's decision to invite the Domnathi vampires

events.summary: Henrika Domnathi kills Relio with crimson tendrils, and Cordelia coldly steps aside.
events.quote: Henrika's crimson tendrils punctured Relio, causing him to bleed out in front of Cordelia

relations.quote: he was killed by Henrika Domnathi
much to the chagrin of his companion, Cordelia Stromkirk
Relio Voldaren was a brash vampire of the Voldaren clan of Stensia on the plane of Innistrad .
